description.value:
You learn to feel your own constellation approaching over the horizon of days.

Frequency once per week

During your daily preparations, you learn whether your Cloth's constellation will be ascendant on any of the next three days, and if so which day and whether it will be Exalted.

This lets you plan: to press for a confrontation on your day, or to counsel delay until the sky turns. You still learn nothing about the other twelve signs.
